title: The Last Starlight · animation pass 3
style: Original 2D cutout cartoon. Midnight teal, warm gold, coral. Mira is a silent mint-metal robot with a yellow scarf, always grounded. Pip is a coral bird.
synopsis: 36-second third animation pass: distance-driven planted feet, lifted passing poses, reflected edges, cel shadows, selective surface marks and smooth scene dissolves. Authored animation is baked into six clips; keep their order for continuity.
